sig: [[["A", "Hi Emma, have you got a minute? I need to talk to you about the sprint deadline."], ["B", "Sure, Mark. Is something wrong? You sound a bit worried."], ["A", "Well, the payment team just told me their new API won't be ready until next Monday."], ["B", "Oh no. We can't finish the checkout page without it, can we?"], ["A", "Not really. So I'd like to move our deadline from this Friday to next Thursday. That gives us three days to test."], ["B", "That sounds reasonable. Have you told the client yet?"], ["A", "Not yet. I wanted to touch base with you first before we tell anyone."], ["B", "OK. I'll send them an email this afternoon and explain the delay."], ["A", "Great, thanks. And could you loop in the QA team too?"], ["B", "Sure. I'll copy them on the email so everyone's on the same page."]], {"A": "M-US", "B": "F-GB"}]
